nodes.description: Immutable public state variable holding the initial interest rate per year (scaled 1e18).
Immutable public state variable holding the minimum allowed interest rate.
Immutable public state variable holding the maximum allowed interest rate.
Immutable public state variable holding the adjustment aggressiveness factor, constrained to be < 1e18 in the constructor.
Constructor validating _minRate < _maxRate and _adjustRate < 1e18, then assigning the four immutable rate state variables.

External view function computing the next interest rate from previous rate, liquidity, loan amount and elapsed time; uses piecewise utilization logic and clamps the result between minRate and maxRate.
Constructor parameter for the initial interest rate.
Constructor parameter for the minimum interest rate; used in the require(_minRate < _maxRate) check.
Constructor parameter for the maximum interest rate; used in the require(_minRate < _maxRate) check.
Constructor parameter for the adjustment rate; validated against 1e18 and later used in the rate multiplier computation.
Current interest rate input to getNextInterestRate.
Current available liquidity input to getNextInterestRate.
Current outstanding loan input to getNextInterestRate.
Time passed since the last interest rate rebase, in seconds, input to getNextInterestRate.
Local computed as totalAvailable + totalLoan; zero is handled by returning prevRate early.
Local utilization rate computed as (totalLoan * 1e18) / totalLiquidity.
Local time passed capped at 1 days via Math.min.
Local multiplier applied to prevRate, selected by the piecewise utilization branches.
Local (0.7e18 - utilRate) * 5 used in the 50-70% utilization branch.
Local (utilRate - 0.8e18) * 5 used in the 80-100% utilization branch.
Local 1e36 / (1e18 - adjustRate) - 1e18, derived from adjustRate, used to scale the upper branch.
Local (prevRate * multRate) / 1e18, the computed rate before clamping; returned to the caller.
Checked multiplication totalLoan * 1e18 used to build utilRate; can revert or behave unexpectedly with extreme inputs.
Checked division 1e36 / (1e18 - adjustRate) followed by subtraction of 1e18; division by zero would revert if adjustRate were >= 1e18.
Checked multiplication prevRate * multRate used to form targetRate; can overflow and revert for large rates.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the _initialRate parameter to the immutable initialRate state variable.
Constructor assigns the _minRate parameter to the immutable minRate state variable.
Constructor assigns the _maxRate parameter to the immutable maxRate state variable.
Constructor assigns the _adjustRate parameter to the immutable adjustRate state variable.
require(_minRate < _maxRate) gates constructor execution based on the _minRate parameter.
require(_adjustRate < 1e18) gates constructor execution based on the _adjustRate parameter.
totalAvailable contributes to the totalLiquidity local.
totalLoan contributes to the totalLiquidity local.
totalLoan is the left operand of the checked multiplication totalLoan * 1e18.
The result of totalLoan * 1e18 flows into the utilRate computation.
totalLiquidity is the denominator in the utilRate computation.
timePassed is capped via Math.min into cappedtimePassed.
adjustRate is the subtracted operand in 1e18 - adjustRate, the divisor of the upMaxRate expression.
The result of 1e36 / (1e18 - adjustRate) - 1e18 is stored in the upMaxRate local.
prevRate is the left operand of the checked multiplication prevRate * multRate.
multRate is the right operand of the checked multiplication prevRate * multRate.
The product prevRate * multRate, divided by 1e18, produces the targetRate local.
utilRate is used in the downScale computation of the 50-70% branch.
cappedtimePassed scales the downScale-based multiplier.
downScale feeds the arithmetic expression producing multRate in the middle-utilization branch.
utilRate is used in the upScale computation of the 80-100% branch.
cappedtimePassed scales the upScale-based multiplier.
upScale feeds the arithmetic expression producing multRate in the high-utilization branch.
upMaxRate is multiplied by upScale and cappedtimePassed inside the multRate expression.
cappedtimePassed directly scales multRate in the decrease and increase branches.
targetRate is clamped by Math.min/Math.max and returned from getNextInterestRate.
minRate is used as the lower bound in the final Math.max clamp.
maxRate is used as the upper bound in the final Math.min clamp.
getNextInterestRate executes the checked multiplication totalLoan * 1e18.
getNextInterestRate executes the checked division 1e36 / (1e18 - adjustRate) - 1e18.
getNextInterestRate executes the checked multiplication prevRate * multRate.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter used solely to initialize the initialRate immutable; can be folded into the constructor node.
Constructor parameter used only in the require bound check and minRate assignment; can be folded into the constructor node.
Constructor parameter used only in the require bound check and maxRate assignment; can be folded into the constructor node.
Constructor parameter validated and stored as adjustRate; its identity is subsumed by the constructor and the derived state variable.
Function parameter directly consumed as the left operand of the prevRate * multRate computation.
Function parameter only contributes to the totalLiquidity local of getNextInterestRate.
Function parameter directly consumed as the operand of the totalLoan * 1e18 computation.
Function parameter only feeds the cappedtimePassed local inside getNextInterestRate.
Intermediate local defining the liquidity denominator; its effect is captured by the enclosing function node.
Local produced directly by the totalLoan * 1e18 arithmetic and its division, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
Intermediate local derived from timePassed via Math.min; subsumed by the enclosing function.
Local directly consumed as the right operand of the prevRate * multRate computation.
Branch-specific intermediate local feeding multRate; subsumed by the enclosing function.
Branch-specific intermediate local feeding multRate; subsumed by the enclosing function.
Local produced directly by the 1e36 / (1e18 - adjustRate) - 1e18 arithmetic operation.
Local that is the quotient of the prevRate * multRate product, directly tied to that unsafe operation.
